fields.why: Figure 2 is a two-way breakdown (agreement by patient group, by provider type), and the text reports no contrast within provider-type strata and no adjustment. A breakdown with no comparison inside strata stays 'comparison'.

The only group variable is provider type, which has three levels (Table; vaccine hesitancy 25%/22%/16%; Figure 2 'by provider type'). B's 'pair' rests on the same respondents answering two policy-option items, which can be defended as the headline contrast but compares items, not groups.

The primary outcome is provider knowledge and acceptability of a vaccine recommendation: vaccine-program data, not coverage, VE or safety. The brief names 'other' but does not say whether knowledge or attitude surveys count as quantifying vaccine epidemiology.

Table rows 'Gender › Female/Male' make sex a descriptor (B omitted it). A's age evidence is about the patient groups in the recommendation, not respondents, whose age is not reported, so age should not be listed.

brief_issues: State whether vaccine_outcome_type applies when the primary outcome is provider or public knowledge, attitudes or acceptability of vaccine recommendations (e.g. 'other').
